descriptions.preferred: This cultivar closely resembles 'Tsuma beni', with which it is often confused. The spring color phase is quite similar. As the foliage unfolds, it tends to droop from the petiole, adding a softness to the general appearance of the plant. The color at this time is a very soft yellow green. The tips of the lobes are shaded with a blend of tones which are difficult to describe. Colors range from Corvallis about halfway to the leaf base. The margins are evenly and lightly serrated. This maple is not a tall-growing cultivar but forms a round-shaped plant up to 3 m tall and wide. Because of the similarity in name, leaf, and form, 'Tsuma gaki' and 'Tsuma beni' may be confused, but they are distinct cultivars. 'Tsuma gaki' has been misspelled

sources.title: 爪柿 Acer Palmatum 'Tsuma Gaki'
sources.description: 经典的日系爪斑品种，春天新叶为明黄色，叶尖和边 缘为红色，红色叶尖会一直保持到夏天，黄色的基调 会逐渐转变为绿色，秋季转变为红色，以七叶裂为主， 生长速度略慢，耐修剪，是非常好的盆景品种，午后 需要适当遮阴，成年株可达 2. 5 米左右。

rhs.description: A slow-growing, compact, rounded shrub or small tree with palmate leaves with 5-7 oval lobes, emerging yellow-green with red-purple tips to the lobes, turning darker green in summer and red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Architectural
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种与 'Tsuma beni' 极为相似，常与之混淆。 其春季叶色阶段十分接近。 叶片展开时常自叶柄处略微下垂，使整株外观显得更柔和。 此时叶色为非常柔和的黄绿色。 裂片尖端带有一种难以准确描述的综合色调。 颜色范围从 Corvallis 处原文残缺可推测，应描述其尖端着色变化。 叶片自叶基向上约一半处分裂。 叶缘均匀且轻微具锯齿。 该枫树不是高大型品种，而是形成圆整株形，高和冠幅均可达 3 米。 由于名称、叶形和株形相近，'Tsuma gaki' 与 'Tsuma beni' 容易混淆，但它们是两个不同的品种。 'Tsuma gaki' 也曾被误拼为 'Tsuma gari'。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢，株形紧凑圆整，可形成灌木或小乔木。 掌状叶具 5-7 个椭圆形裂片，春季展叶时为黄绿色，裂片尖端带红紫色，夏季转为较深的绿色，秋季变红。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护、露台/容器植物、结构型植物
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

products.name: Acer palmatum ‘Tsuma gaki’ Specimen 1127
products.description_text: Yellow-green leaves emerge cupped with burgundy-orange tips. It looks as if the entire tree is unfolding soft flowers (the leaves) - others have described it as flocking birds.
